g.text: Automatic right-sizing of AWS Transform MGN replication servers
Invoke Lambda manually for dry-run or apply
EventBridge invokes Lambda with fixed target settings
Lambda assumes the exact target-account IAM role
Role authorizes AWS Transform MGN inventory and configuration APIs
AWS Transform MGN manages the replication server configuration
Replication servers write replicated blocks to staging volumes
Sum provisioned capacity of all source disks
Select the highest matching SIZE_TIERS entry
Replication type changes restart that server
